name: Provenance glow stroke
looks: One accent-coloured soft glow marks whatever is currently live, be it an active chip, a panel's border or a typing cursor, while everything else stays flat and neutral. The glow moves from element to element as the action moves, so the eye always knows where to look.
build: Apply a shared live class with a box-shadow glow or a blurred duplicate layer behind whichever element is active, driving its intensity and colour as a pure function of the clock and crossfading it from one element to the next on the beat, never showing more than one live element at a time.
prompt: Run one soft, saturated glow through the whole film that marks only whatever is currently active, be it a button, a panel edge or a cursor, and nothing else. Let it hand off from element to element in time with the action so it reads as a single thread of attention tying every scene together, and never let more than one thing glow at once.
